prompt_structural_pattern: Short social or professional situation scenario (40-70 words). The examinee must formulate an appropriate spontaneous spoken reply adhering to social register.
grammatical_focus: Polite requests, apologies, and pragmatic hedging.

sample_generated_item.prompt_text: You are assisting a customer at a regional transit hub who missed their scheduled coach to Brisbane. Explain the rebooking options politely.
sample_generated_item.canonical_answer: I apologize for the inconvenience. Our next scheduled coach departs at two o'clock, and I can transfer your ticket at no additional charge.
